name: Assegno Unico Universale - SIA Project 24 25
description: The system supports the online management of applications for the Italian Assegno Unico Universale (AUU), a financial benefit provided by INPS to families with dependent children. Authenticated applicants can create applications, specify child, household, custody and payment information, save drafts, resume applications, accept declarations and privacy notices, and submit applications. The system validates fiscal codes, handles ISEE information, calculates payments, and allows INPS employees to accept, reject or suspend applications. Suspended applications may require additional documents. Another parent can complete an existing application and modify allowance distribution information. Applicants can also add children to existing applications, consult submitted applications, access general AUU information, and simulate the expected monthly allowance.
rawDescription: The system supports the online management of applications for the Italian Assegno Unico Universale (AUU), a financial benefit provided by INPS to families with dependent children. Authenticated applicants can create applications, specify child, household, custody and payment information, save drafts, resume applications, accept declarations and privacy notices, and submit applications. The system validates fiscal codes, handles ISEE information, calculates payments, and allows INPS employees to accept, reject or suspend applications. Suspended applications may require additional documents. Another parent can complete an existing application and modify allowance distribution information. Applicants can also add children to existing applications, consult submitted applications, access general AUU information, and simulate the expected monthly allowance.
highLevelGoals: To successfully apply for the Assegno Unico Universale benefit for their dependent children.
To have the flexibility to create, save, resume, and update their AUU benefit applications at their convenience.
To access comprehensive information about the AUU benefit and estimate potential allowance amounts.
To track the progress and status of their submitted AUU benefit applications.
To effectively review, approve, reject, or suspend AUU applications to ensure timely benefit decisions.
To verify the validity of applicant data and ensure correct benefit calculations according to regulations.
To handle applications requiring additional documentation or special attention.
To contribute to and finalize an AUU application initiated by another parent.
To modify how the AUU benefit is distributed among eligible parties.
lowLevelGoals: Applicant sends a request to the system to start a new AUU benefit application.
Applicant inputs and submits their personal identification details (e.g., tax code, name, surname) to the system for the application.
Applicant inputs and submits the required details for each dependent child (e.g., name, date of birth, tax code) to the system.
Applicant inputs or links their ISEE declaration details to the application in the system.
Applicant selects and submits their preferred method for receiving the benefit (e.g., bank transfer, postal order) to the system.
Applicant requests and views a comprehensive summary of all entered application data before final submission.
Applicant sends a request to the system to formally submit their completed AUU benefit application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to save the current state of an incomplete AUU application as a draft.
Applicant sends a request to the system to retrieve and load a previously saved draft of an AUU application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to modify data within a specific section of a draft AUU application.
Applicant inputs and submits details for a new dependent child to be added to an existing (draft or submitted) AUU application.
Applicant uploads specific additional documents to the system in response to a request for more information for a suspended AUU application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to permanently remove a saved draft of an AUU application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to access general descriptive information about the AUU benefit.
Applicant inputs specific family income and composition data into the system to calculate an estimated benefit amount.
Applicant sends a request to the system to display the calculated estimated AUU allowance amount based on provided data.
Applicant sends a request to the system to access detailed rules and conditions for AUU benefit eligibility.
Applicant sends a request to the system to fetch a list of all AUU applications they have previously submitted.
Applicant sends a request to the system to display the current processing status of a particular submitted AUU application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to fetch any notifications or alerts related to their submitted application.
Applicant sends a request to the system to download official documents or communications pertaining to their application.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to fetch a list of all AUU applications awaiting review.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to display all details of a specific AUU application.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to mark a specific AUU application as approved.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to mark a specific AUU application as rejected, providing a mandatory reason.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to suspend a specific AUU application, triggering a request for additional information from the applicant.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to reassign a specific AUU application to another INPS employee for processing.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to verify the applicant's identity against external national databases.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to verify the details of dependent children against external national databases.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to fetch the official ISEE declaration data for an applicant from the relevant national database.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to initiate an automatic calculation of the AUU benefit amount based on verified application data.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to flag an application for manual review due to detected data discrepancies or inconsistencies.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to formally ask an applicant for specific additional documents for their application.
INPS Employee uploads supplementary documents received from an applicant or other sources to a specific application in the system.
INPS Employee adds internal, private notes or comments to an application for tracking special attention or context.
INPS Employee sends a request to the system to mark an application's exception status as resolved after all issues have been addressed.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to accept an invitation to collaborate on an existing AUU application initiated by another parent.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to view the details of an AUU application shared with them for collaboration.
Co-parent inputs and submits their personal identification details for the shared application.
Co-parent uploads any documents specifically required from them for the shared application.
Co-parent inputs and submits modifications or completes missing sections within an AUU application shared with them for collaboration.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to confirm their completion and submission of their part of the shared application.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to propose a specific percentage for how the AUU benefit should be distributed.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to view the currently proposed or agreed-upon distribution of the AUU benefit.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to confirm their agreement to the proposed benefit distribution.
Co-parent sends a request to the system to modify the payment method for their specific share of the AUU benefit.

baselineCritiques.actors: The identified actors are accurate and cover the main user roles described in the text: the primary applicant, the INPS staff for administrative processing, and the co-parent who can modify or complete applications. There are no obvious omissions or contradictions.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The provided high-level goals are well-aligned with the system description and actors. They correctly capture the functional needs of the Applicant (applying, managing drafts, understanding benefits, monitoring status), the INPS Employee (processing, compliance, handling exceptions), and the Co-parent (collaborating, modifying distribution). There are no non-functional goals (like security or performance) included, which is correct per the instruction to ensure ONLY functional goals are present. The goals are representative of the core functionalities described.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are comprehensive and well-aligned with the high-level goals and the software description. They correctly capture the functional actions for all three actors (Applicant, INPS Employee, Co-parent). The goals are specific, atomic, and functional. There are no obvious contradictions or major omissions regarding the core functionalities described (application creation, management, processing, collaboration, and simulation). The inclusion of specific actions like "Trigger Automatic Benefit Calculation" and "Verify Applicant Identity" appropriately addresses the system's validation and calculation requirements.
